pois.name: Bundaran HI
pois.description: Jakarta's iconic central roundabout featuring the Welcome Monument (Selamat Datang). The symbolic heart of the city and a popular gathering point.

pois.name: Wisma 46
pois.description: One of Jakarta's most distinctive skyscrapers at 262m, with its iconic pencil-shaped spire. Headquarters of Bank BNI and a defining feature of the SCBD skyline.

pois.name: Menara BCA
pois.description: 230m glass tower, one of the tallest buildings in Indonesia and the tallest in the Grand Indonesia complex.

pois.name: Grand Indonesia
pois.description: Jakarta's premier luxury shopping mall complex spanning 557,000m² — the largest mall in Southeast Asia. Home to over 600 international and local brands.

pois.name: Masjid Istiqlal
pois.description: The largest mosque in Southeast Asia, inaugurated in 1978. A masterpiece of modern Islamic architecture with a 45m silver dome, symbolising Indonesian independence.

pois.name: Plaza Indonesia
pois.description: Upmarket shopping centre anchoring the Thamrin Boulevard corridor, home to luxury labels and flagship restaurants.

pois.name: Katedral Jakarta
pois.description: Jakarta Cathedral (1901), one of the city's finest examples of Gothic Revival architecture. Its twin neo-Gothic spires face the Istiqlal Mosque across the square.

pois.name: Monumen Selamat Datang
pois.description: The Welcome Monument at Bundaran HI — two bronze figures welcoming visitors, designed by Edhi Sunarso and inaugurated by Sukarno in 1962.
